name: Goliade
source:
A spirit who has a contract with Ayers. Goliade is a well-balanced fighter with a bird's head and a muscular body.

[Translated from [url=https://www.prot.co.jp/ps2/polyphonica2/index.html]PS2 edition's official website[/url].]
